messages.subject: caching images
parts:
I just created a shiny app that lets users view maps of countries under different projections:

app: https://arilamstein.shinyapps.io/admin1-demo
source code: https://github.com/arilamstein/admin1-projection-demo

It takes about 14 seconds to load a map. The initial map is always the same. Is it possible to save that image to disk, and have shiny return that saved image when the inputs are country="japan", projection1="none", projection2="mercator"?

More generally, is it possible for the app to save each image it creates as a png, and then return these cached images when they exist?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: caching images
parts:
Yes, this article should help:
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/images.html

Be sure to set your plotOutput's width and height to explicit, constant values (by default plots are scaled to the width of their container).
